origin: cwe/94/php Taint Sinks: include/require with user-controlled path

finding.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code
finding.summary: A request-controlled plugin name is concatenated into a require path, allowing attacker-selected PHP code to be loaded and executed.

trap: Setting allow_url_include=0, checking for http:// URLs, or sanitizing path separators while still allowing arbitrary local plugin names. Local require() execution remains; the fix must use a server-owned allowlist of plugin identifiers to fixed files.
must_preserve: The existing summary plugin remains the default, approved plugins can still render previews through render_preview(), and rejected plugin names fail before require() executes.
